constantValue.en: Gluten-Free Options: Any signature burger can be prepared on a gluten-free bun or wrapped in crisp leaf lettuce upon request.
Vegetarian Choices: Substitute our plant-based smash patty on any burger style at no additional charge.
Nutritional Info: Estimated calorie counts are explicitly listed next to each item category below to guide your dining choices.
Substitutions: We gladly accommodate side substitutions (e.g., swapping hand-cut fries for a side salad or truffle fries).

en.html:
• Weekday Happy Hour: Monday through Friday from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM. Includes rotating specials on house cocktails, local draft beers, shareable appetizers, and select single-patty burgers.
  • Weekend Brunch Menu: Available every Saturday and Sunday from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM, featuring brunch burgers, brisket hash, chicken & waffles, breakfast tacos, and craft mimosas.
  • Kids Menu: Tailored for guests 12 and under. Includes a choice of cheeseburger, grilled chicken tenders, mac & cheese, or buttered pasta, served with hand-cut fries or seasonal fresh fruit and a fountain drink.
